Facts: (1) User-facing symptom: ts-ui-dashboard POST /preserveservice/preserve returns 500 (14/22 calls, avg 7.2s) and loadgenerator sees 20s timeouts. (4) ts-travel-service p99 spikes (hubble 4.85s) and its getTripAllDetailInfo p99 2.7s vs 0.78s: propagated latency from basic. Conclusion: a single primary fault locus at ts-basic-service (connection resets + severe latency in the 00:30-00:34 window), propagating to preserve (500s), ui-dashboard (500s/timeouts), loadgenerator (timeouts), and travel (latency). Confidence on the exact mechanism inside basic (vs. a connection-level issue on the path) is moderate; the telemetry does not show basic's own spans failing, so I'll state that. Ready to write findings.
